exact_statement: For every Boolean uniform-cube function and supplied normalized supporting empty-calibrated spectral reference R, the per-set uniform-mark lift J has CE(J_P,J_R)=CE(P,R)+L(P), D(J_P||J_R)=D(P||R), and 0<=L(P)<=I-Var. Under every physical query the explicit keep-surviving-mark/reselect-if-deleted kernel commutes with actual child spectral transport, outcome normalization and empty calibration, including reference-only fibers and biased/constant children. Its lifted CE release is scalar release plus lambda_i=sum_{i in S,|S|>=2} P(S)log2(|S|/(|S|-1)); its extra mark-reselection entropy is rho_i=sum P(S)log2(|S|-1)/|S|<=(2/5)Inf_i, with optimal pointwise constant attained by parity_5. Every finite adaptive tree retains complete terminal CE and satisfies the exact CE and L telescopes; total reselection entropy<=(2/5)(I_root-E I_leaf). Charging both gives bill<=CE(P_root,R_root)+(7/5)I_root-Var_root-(2/5)E I_leaf. Parity_8 has rho_i>lambda_i, and their ratio is unbounded along parity_d, so this explicit reselection invoice cannot be funded only from L release. Furthermore m(d)=sum_{j=2}^d log2(j-1)/j has physical drift rho_i exactly. With M(P)=E m(|S|) and c_star=[log2(5)+log2(3)/4+11/15]/5<7/10, every finite tree has combined bill=rootCE+E_P w(|S|)-E M_leaf<=rootCE+c_star I_root-E M_leaf, where w(d)=log2(d)+m(d). The optimal overhead coefficient for this explicit kernel/accounting convention is c_star, attained by a complete parity_5 restriction tree. No universal initial reference price or full FEI is supplied.
